embed.missingHint: Embed a subtitle file when the converted video won't have a subtitle track in its language already.
embed.alwaysHint: Embed every subtitle file, even in languages the video already has.
embed.neverHint: Don't embed subtitle files; they can still be copied next to the video.

copy.alwaysHint: Copy every subtitle file next to the converted video, embedded or not.
copy.notEmbeddedHint: Copy only the subtitle files that were not embedded into the video.
copy.neverHint: Don't copy subtitle files to the target folder.

why.excluded: Unticked: not used for this job.
why.missing: Embedded: the converted video won't have a subtitle track in this language.
why.present: Not embedded: the converted video already has a subtitle track in this language.
why.unknownLang: Not embedded: its language is unknown and the video already has subtitles. Choose a language to decide.
why.container: Can't be embedded into this format (WebM: none; MP4: text subtitles only). It can still be copied.

job.title: Subtitle files
job.notLooked: Not looked for yet: this happens after the source is read.
job.none: No subtitle files next to the source.
job.includeTitle: Use this subtitle file for this job
job.detectedAs: Found as {lang} in the file name
job.forcedTitle: Forced subtitles: only the lines in a foreign language. When embedded, the track is marked forced and default.
job.sdhTitle: For the deaf and hard of hearing (with sound descriptions)
job.lookAgainTitle: Look again for subtitle files next to the source (keeps the choices made here)
job.containerCopied: {container} can't hold {names}: they won't be embedded, and are copied next to the video instead.
job.containerLost: {container} can't hold {names}, and copying is off: they won't be used. Choose a copy option or an MKV preset.

result.writeAgainTitle: Writes the subtitle files next to the converted video again, with the current edits (replacing the ones written before)
result.prepareFailed: Subtitle files could not be prepared: {error}

editor.title: Edit {name}
editor.readOnly: The job is converting: changes can be made when it has finished.
editor.sourceKept: The original file is not changed: the edits are kept with this job and applied to the copy that is embedded or written next to the video.
editor.offsetHint: Positive: the subtitles appear later. Negative: earlier.
editor.fpsHint: For subtitles that start in sync and drift further apart: they were timed for a video with another frame rate (e.g. 25 → 23.976).
editor.codesetHint: If accented letters look wrong, choose the character set the file was written in. The copies are always UTF-8.
editor.cleanTagsHint: Italic, bold, colours and position tags
editor.cleanAdsHint: Lines such as "Subtitles by…" and web addresses
editor.cleanOverlapsHint: A line ends just before the next one starts
editor.more_one: … {count} more line: search to find it
editor.more_other: … {count} more lines: search to narrow down

queue.title: What happens to subtitle files next to the videos, for the whole queue
queue.titleCustom: Subtitle files for the whole queue: embed {embed}, copy {copy}
queue.intro: Applies to every job in the queue, now and added later, that has no choice of its own (set in its details).
queue.jobsKeep: A job converting now is not affected.

browser.title_one: {count} subtitle file next to this video: {list}
browser.title_other: {count} subtitle files next to this video: {list}
